title: Liu's conjecture on gap-level excedance and Denert statistics
statement: Let $g\geq 1$ and $\ell\geq 1$, and let $g\mathsf{exc}_\ell$ and $g\mathsf{den}_\ell$ denote the $g$-gap $\ell$-level excedance number and $g$-gap $\ell$-level Denert statistic, respectively. Set $r=g+\ell-1$. A pair of permutation statistics is $r$-Euler-Mahonian when its bivariate distribution over $\mathfrak{S}_n$ agrees with that of $(r\mathsf{des},r\mathsf{maj})$. **Liu's conjecture.** For all $g\geq 1$ and $\ell\geq 1$, the pair $(g\mathsf{exc}_\ell,g\mathsf{den}_\ell)$ is $r$-Euler-Mahonian, where $r=g+\ell-1$. The paper's abstract says that its main objective is to confirm this conjecture, and the supplied proof passage says that a bijective proof is obtained; however, no explicit status evidence field is supplied for this candidate.
source_name: Kaimei Huang and Sherry H. F. Yan, “Further results on r-Euler-Mahonian statistics”, arXiv:2501.12083 (2025).
references:
**2 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2024–2025). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:2408.04185](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.04185).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.12083

Status: **solved** according to the source (as of January 2025). “This conjecture was first proved by Foata and Zeilberger and a bijective proof was provided by Han .”
